ja.title: 摂動予測の上限はどこか。同じ細胞での再現性から考える
ja.summary: 背景をまたぐ摂動予測の評価の前に、同じ細胞での再現性から相関の上限を知る必要がある。Nadig 2025の補正相関を手がかりに、評価で確かめたい点を整理する。

en.title: Before evaluating cross-context perturbation prediction: know the reproducibility bound
en.summary: Noise-corrected Perturb-seq correlations clarify what cross-context virtual-cell prediction scores can and cannot show.

english.title: Before evaluating cross-context perturbation prediction: know the reproducibility bound
english.summary: A Japanese essay arguing that cross-cell-line perturbation predictions should be read against within-context reproducibility, using the noise-corrected correlations reported by Nadig et al. (2025). No new analysis.
